utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Eli, the repair drive’s really taking off—people have been dropping off tools all morning, and I’m planning to tell the Millers after lunch and Jo too if I see her out front.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds like a solid plan, Tess. I’ll keep track of what gets fixed and what’s still pending so we can give everyone a clear update this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’ll help a lot, Eli—folks will want a clear update, and I’ll spread the word once I’ve talked to the Millers and Jo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—where do you want me on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—I’m still waiting on the date myself, but I’ve been telling everyone to keep an eye out and spread the word once it’s announced.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll keep an eye out too and help spread the word once we’ve got the date.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know the folding tables still need repair, and Sam said he’d bring the basic tools. I’m still quietly confirming what else needs fixing and exactly what tools he’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds alright. I can quietly pass Rosa a couple more names for tools, and she can sort the rest once you’ve confirmed the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll keep checking quietly on what still needs fixing and ask Sam for the exact tool list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal—repair drive’s still on, so just drop stuff at Leo’s porch before 6 and slap a note on anything weird.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I’ve got the repair drive itself noted for the school parking lot at 9 a.m., and I’ll mark Leo’s porch drop-off cutoff as before 6.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s the gist—school lot at 9, porch drop-off before 6, and note anything odd.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s off to a good start—Dane’s already jumped in on sorting the bike parts, and a few neighbors dropped off tools. If you’ve got time, we could really use help checking the small appliances next.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that, but before I jump in, are we still keeping the repair drive to bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, and is Saturday afternoon still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, still the same focus—bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture—and we’re still on for Saturday afternoon. If that works for you, I’d love to have you on the small appliances table.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s still just bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, and Saturday afternoon was what I had in mind—unless we changed that?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That still matches what I have too—bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, Saturday afternoon. If you want, I can start telling a few neighbors so we can get a rough headcount.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right—go ahead and tell a few neighbors, and maybe mention it’s just bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture for Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Gus—I’m still out on errands, so just keep me posted this afternoon on what’s fixed and what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Ira—I’ll send you an update this afternoon on what we get fixed and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your update this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m glad to pitch in, Leo—if the repair drive needs a hand, I can sort tools or help set up tables. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Start with the tables at my porch around 5, and if you can, sort the basic tools into one box so setup goes quicker.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll be at your porch around 5 to set up the tables and get the basic tools sorted into one box.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d feel better if we had the organizer’s name and a direct confirmation first, especially on the date and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s the organizer, then, and can you get me direct confirmation on the date and pickup details today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t know who the organizer is yet, and that’s exactly why I’m hesitant to plan around it—let’s get a named contact and a direct confirmation before anyone starts hauling things over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s really taking off, Cleo—if you see anyone headed our way, send them along and let them know we’re fixing things all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’ve got the supplies list with me, so if anyone asks, I’ll point them your way and make sure they know the repair drive’s running all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—that’ll help a lot; I’m thinking we should spread the word to the Millers and Jo too so they can bring anything by if they’ve got repairs waiting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: They’re holding the repair drive in the school parking lot starting at 9 a.m.; I’m planning to head over right after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks, Faye—I did have the day right for once. Do you remember if I’m supposed to bring tools, or just the spare cords and little appliances?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I only heard to bring the spare cords and small appliances, not tools—but I can double-check when I get there after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Nell, I’m pulling together the repair drive schedule now—could you help me sort out who can bring tools and who’s hoping to get something fixed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help with that—I’d only heard the repair drive was coming up, so I can start asking around about tools and who needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Nell—thank you. If you can jot down names and what folks can bring or need fixed, I’ll pull it into the schedule and keep everything organized.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
